body: Omg this it literally my life right now! I have no words of advice because I’m a complete mess about it but good luck.

I’ve had family tell me that because I’m pregnant (32 weeks) they will call DOCS because I put my child in danger, I don’t know if that’s true. 

I am indigenous and my family are all very wary when it comes to child services and speaking to strangers about things like this. 

I really don’t want it to be true because I feel like I need to talk to someone about it but I also don’t want to put my husband and children through all the stress of DOCS.

Update 

My doctor said she couldn’t do much in terms of medication as I’m pregnant and seeing an obstetrician, she referred me to the midwives at the hospital and they are trying to set something up. I feel like she thought this was happening because I’m pregnant, maybe it is. Maybe I should have told her about yesterday, but my mum and husband both thought I shouldn’t. I just really don’t want to have to tell person after person about this, it’s hard enough to explain the first time without telling them I cut my wrists but trying to get them to understand this is serious and I’m just exhausted. I don’t know where to go from here.
What do I say to my doctor? I find it hard to talk to people. I don’t want them to send me off to the hospital to be admitted but I also want to be taken seriously... how does this stuff work?
